propositions: The lifespan drain waits only for queue.join() and does not protect reconciler reviews that await review_and_vote inline, causing in-flight reconciler work to be cancelled within shutdown_cancel_seconds instead of drained over shutdown_drain_seconds
Any container stop other than autodeploy-deferred restarts kills an in-progress reconciler review with no drain, including manual docker compose restart, host reboot, and autodeploy rollback
The shutdown must not allow new reviews to start once draining begins, enforced via cooperative request_stop signal before waiting
A shared shutdown_drain_seconds budget must cover both the webhook queue and reconciler in-flight work, gated on voter.in_flight_reviews with no independent timeout windows
The reconciler stop path must record held_back candidates to preserve the low-water-mark cursor invariant and prevent unreachable gaps
After lifespan shutdown completes, the stop flag must be cleared so subsequent reconcile_once calls in the same process do not silently reject all candidates
